name: font of inspiration
desc: Beginning when you reach 5th level, you regain all of your expended uses of @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.classfeatures.Item.hpLNiGq7y67d2EHA]{Bardic Inspiraton} when you finish a short or long rest.
Bardic Inspiration is set to long rest recovery by default. Please edit to short rest upon reaching this level.
